newsitem.title: USA: Eagle Hardware & Garden prices offering.
newsitem.headline: Eagle Hardware & Garden prices offering.

text.p: Eagle Hardware & Garden Inc Tuesday said it priced its public offering of five million shares of common stock at $22-7/8 a share.
All shares are being sold by the company.
In a statement, the company said the offering represented an increase of 500,000 shares over the amount originally announced on Aug. 22.
The company has granted the underwriters an option to purchase up to 750,000 additional shares to cover over-allotments, if any.
Proceeds from the sale of shares will be used to finance Eagle's expansion program, repay bank borrowings and for general corporate purposes.
